skill.name: proxy-troubleshooting
skill.description: Diagnose residential proxy failures, with NodeMaven's gateway as the reference - 407 with correct credentials, 406, 410, 500, a connection that hangs, ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED in a browser, Playwright or Puppeteer ignoring proxy credentials, a sticky session that changes IP, geo-targeting that is silently ignored, passwords with special characters, and unexpected traffic from headless Chrome. Use when a proxy connection fails, returns the wrong location, or costs more traffic than expected.
skill.summary: Troubleshoot NodeMaven proxy status codes, browser authentication, session changes, geographic targeting, and unexpected Chrome traffic.
skill.author: nodemaven

security_audit.summary: Of 45 static findings, 43 are false positives involving Markdown, legitimate diagnostics, or documented browser limitations. Two HTTP proxy examples expose credentials because proxy authentication travels outside the destination HTTPS tunnel without transport encryption. No evidence found of prompt injection, malicious exfiltration, or system reconnaissance in the reviewed skill.

remediation.issue: The curl and Playwright examples authenticate through an unencrypted HTTP proxy connection.
remediation.suggestion: Use a verified TLS-enabled proxy endpoint where supported, or require a trusted encrypted transport. Explain that destination HTTPS does not protect proxy authentication.

content.user_title: Diagnose Proxy Failures and Browser Traffic
content.value_statement: Proxy failures can hide gateway errors, break browser authentication, and increase traffic costs. This skill provides NodeMaven-focused checks for status codes, routing, sessions, and Chrome downloads.
actual_capabilities: Explain how to reveal gateway status codes with a filtered curl diagnostic or the NodeMaven SDK health check.
Map documented NodeMaven responses to invalid targeting values, account restrictions, missing regions, and empty username parameters.
Identify browser authentication mistakes and credential URL encoding problems.
Guide exit IP checks when client configuration bypasses the proxy.
Explain sticky session changes and ignored geographic targeting parameters.
Suggest Chrome feature flag checks for unexpected background model downloads.
limitations: This skill contains guidance, not bundled diagnostic software or an autonomous monitoring service.
Status code interpretations and username rules are specific to the documented NodeMaven gateway behavior.
Live checks require network access, suitable tools, and authorized proxy account access.
Residential exit availability and Chrome behavior vary; the skill cannot guarantee stable IP addresses or traffic savings.

use_cases.description: Check gateway responses, location values, and client routing when a proxy returns the wrong exit IP or country.

use_cases.title: Investigate Unexpected Proxy Usage

prompt_templates.title: Start With a Browser Error
prompt_templates.prompt: My browser reports ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED with NodeMaven. Explain the first diagnostic checks. Use placeholders and do not request credentials.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: identify the gateway response behind a browser error.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Authentication Settings
prompt_templates.prompt: Curl works but Playwright returns 407. Review this redacted configuration: [configuration]. Check credential placement, encoding, and proxy transport security.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare clients that use the same authorized proxy account.

prompt_templates.title: Trace Session and Location Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: My sticky session changes IP and sometimes country. Review these redacted parameters: [parameters]. Check session delimiters, targeting values, TTL, and exit availability.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: distinguish session identity mistakes from residential exit changes.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Chrome Traffic and Flags
prompt_templates.prompt: Fresh Chrome profiles consume unexpected proxy traffic. Review this sanitized launch configuration: [configuration]. Assess background downloads, duplicate feature flags, and build compatibility before suggesting changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: investigate bandwidth usage across browser automation environments.

output_examples.input: Curl connects successfully, but Playwright returns 407 with the same credentials.
output: Check whether the credentials were embedded in the proxy server URL.
Pass the proxy server, username, and password as separate Playwright fields.
Check NodeMaven targeting values if authentication still fails.
Use encrypted proxy transport where supported, and keep authorization headers out of shared logs.

output_examples.input: The sticky session ID stays the same, but the exit IP changes after I add a country filter.
output: NodeMaven session identity depends on the entire parameter set, not only the session ID.
Changing the country filter creates a different session even when the session ID stays unchanged.
Keep parameters consistent when comparing requests, and account for TTL expiration or unavailable exits.

output_examples.input: A fresh Chrome profile uses proxy traffic before opening a page.
output: The skill identifies background model downloads as a possible source of idle traffic.
Inspect the actual launch arguments for repeated feature flags and a missing OptimizationHints setting.
Test any flag change on your browser build and compare multiple runs before drawing conclusions.

best_practices: Capture only filtered gateway status output, and redact credentials and authorization headers before sharing diagnostics.
Validate targeting values against the account location catalogue and keep session parameters consistent during comparisons.
Use authorized test destinations and encrypted proxy transport where available; verify routing before running larger workloads.
anti_patterns: Sharing complete verbose curl logs that may contain proxy authorization headers.
Assuming every 407 response means an incorrect password instead of checking targeting parameter values.
Retrying blocked exits indefinitely or changing session parameters while expecting the same exit IP.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Live diagnostics still require the appropriate local tools and network permissions.

faq.question: Does the skill require a NodeMaven account?
faq.answer: You can read the guidance without an account. Authenticated gateway checks and account location lookups require authorized NodeMaven access.

faq.question: Why can correct credentials still produce a 407?
faq.answer: The documented NodeMaven gateway also returns 407 for unsupported parameter values. Check country, filter, TTL, type, and speed settings.

faq.question: Can I share verbose curl output?
faq.answer: Do not share complete verbose output. It may contain proxy authorization headers; share filtered status information and redact sensitive values.

faq.question: Does an HTTPS destination protect HTTP proxy credentials?
faq.answer: No. Authentication to an HTTP proxy happens outside the destination TLS tunnel. Use verified encrypted proxy transport where supported.

faq.question: Will the skill guarantee stable sessions or lower traffic costs?
faq.answer: No. Residential exits can disappear, sessions can expire, and Chrome background downloads vary. Validate behavior with controlled tests on your browser build.
